verdict.rationale: Lium documents some data-handling security controls: pod volumes are encrypted at rest by default on default templates, sensitive work can be filtered to Confidential Computing nodes, and volume backups are kept for 2 days. There is no evidence of SOC 2 or other compliance attestations, datacenter tier information, or a trust center for verifying posture before deployment. Missing for 10: SOC 2/compliance certifications, datacenter tier disclosures, a trust/security documentation page, data-handling/privacy policy detail, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can verify the provider's security and compliance posture (SOC 2, data handling, datacenter tiers) before putting proprietary models on it

citations.quote: pod volumes encrypted at rest by default on the default templates
For sensitive work, filter **Browse Pods** for **Confidential Computing** nodes.
a new pod's local volume is backed up on a regular schedule and kept 2 days
